reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent comparison of the retail CFG with the recompiled candidate object symbol.

call_sequence: call eax @ symbol+0x5a (cached g_a43e70(buffer, g_a43e68), when non-null)

comparison.property: load g_a96598 before the store; disabled state returns 0
String_VFormat(buffer, format, va_list) with the same argument order
callback pointer loaded once, g_a43e70(buffer, g_a43e68) called, its EAX returned
fallback callee Debug_Error(buffer) with the buffer as the format argument
fallback never returns (retail jmp $, candidate eb fe self-jump)
no extra calls or writes (the previous candidate zero-initialized the buffer, emitting a memset retail does not have; the initializer was removed)
frame allocation order: retail sub esp,0x400 before the disabled-state test; GCC shrink-wraps the frame after that return
epilogue shape: retail shares 0x004B7E60 with add esp,0x400; the candidate duplicates a small epilogue on the callback path
symbol extent: 102 retail bytes vs 109 candidate instruction bytes (plus 3 alignment bytes); instruction selection differs

summary: Control-flow decisions, globals touched, call order, call arguments, return paths and the non-returning fallback match retail. The previously reported divergence (Error_Show("%s", buffer) followed by a return) is gone: the object now relocates against _Debug_Error and ends the fallback in eb fe. Remaining differences are GCC frame/epilogue placement, not behaviour.
limitations: Retail CFG is Binary Ninja vs Radare2 on the retail image; angr CFGFast split the function at calls (9 blocks, 10 edges) with no unresolved jumps. The candidate graph is the compiled object disassembly, not a formal retail-vs-candidate isomorphism score.
The candidate object was not linked; no claim is made about the current build-clean-win32/igi1.exe image.

The retail callback installer (0x004B8B00 reset clears 0x00A43E70/0x00A43E68) and the 0x00A96598 writer 0x004B8970 are not ported, so the candidate has no way to arm the callback or clear the disabled state at runtime; the branches are present but never taken with different global values.

The retail display/exit callbacks (0x004988D0 MessageBoxA, 0x00498930 DebugBreak+exit) are unported, so the candidate Debug_Error returns 0 when no callback is installed; the explicit self-loop then reproduces retail jmp $.
